intended_object: The negative nilradical n⁻ = ⨁_{α<0} L_α: the Lie subalgebra spanned by the root spaces of the negative roots, for the positive system given by a base b of the root system of a Killing Lie algebra relative to a splitting Cartan subalgebra H. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the cited reference (Humphreys §10.1).
explanation: The body is `rootSpaceSubalgebra H (negRoots (IsKilling.rootSystem H) b) _`. Its carrier is `rootSpaceSpan H S`, the supremum of the weight spaces of L at the roots α ∈ S, i.e. the span of the root spaces L_α for α in S. `negRoots P b = {i | ¬ b.IsPos i}`. For a base every root is either positive or negative, so this is exactly the set of negative roots. `H.root` contains only nonzero roots, so the Cartan subalgebra (the zero weight space) is correctly excluded. The carrier is therefore ⨁_{α<0} L_α. Closure under the bracket is supplied separately, by proving that the negative roots form a special closed set; it does not change the carrier. The setting (Killing Lie algebra over a characteristic-zero field, splitting Cartan subalgebra, base of the associated root system) is the standard one for this notion, and the definition needs it. At this commit Mathlib has no root-space-based nilradical. `LieAlgebra.Basis.borelLower` is related but is a different construction: the Lie span of the generators f_i of a Chevalley-type basis structure. So no exact counterpart is given.
